parameters.general.layer.name: Layer name
parameters.general.layer.description: Name of this layer. A layer can locally override the base parameters and exert force fields.
parameters.general.source.name: Source name
parameters.general.opacity.name: Opacity
parameters.general.opacity.description: Layers can overwrite basic parameters and exert force fields. The opacity is specified with this parameter between 0 and 1. A value of 1 means that parameters in the core area of the layer can be completely overwritten, while a value of 0 means that the layer has no effect.
parameters.general.share.name: Relative strength
parameters.general.share.description: Energy that cells release, for example through radiation, energy costs or decay, is emitted as energy particles. A part of them is created directly next to the cell, the rest in the radiation sources. This parameter determines the fraction that is created in this radiation source. It also scales the external energy inflow for this source. The relative strengths of all radiation sources and of the base add up to 1.
parameters.location.layerposition.name: Position (x,y)
parameters.location.layerposition.descri: Center of the layer in world coordinates.
parameters.location.layervelocity.name: Velocity (x,y)
parameters.location.layervelocity.descri: Velocity by which the layer moves through the world per time step.
parameters.location.sourceposition.name: Position (x,y)
parameters.location.sourceposition.descr: Center of the radiation source in world coordinates.
parameters.location.sourcevelocity.name: Velocity (x,y)
parameters.location.sourcevelocity.descr: Velocity by which the radiation source moves through the world per time step.
